messages:
alice: FYI product wants to retire `X-Route-Pref` and fold routing into the new `Routing-Policy` payload. Need cross-team plan: console UX, SDKs, telemetry, and quota impacts.
dan: +1. quotas are tricky: route-based quotas currently keyed by header value. If we change format we must map old keys to new ones for billing continuity.
rachel: For console: propose an "Incoming mapping" screen where admins can preview header->policy translations and bulk-accept mappings. Also a banner for tenants affected.
tom: SDK side: plan adapter layers (py/ts/go) that translate old header into new policy until end-of-life. default on for two releases then opt-out. API should emit a single startup warning.
alice: telemetry: we need an explicit dimension `routing.policy.source` = ["header_v1","payload_v2","proxy"]. That will let us segment quota billing vs route telemetry.
dan: migration note: billing must preserve historical bucket attribution. Ops: can we alias quota keys for 90 days? If not, we'll need a migration run to copy usage ledgers.
infra-bot: scheduled job created: que/route-policy-migration-plan -> run-checks @ 2024-06-01 01:00 UTC.
rachel: UX question: should mapping UX include a "suggested" auto-map using heuristics (e.g., header values like "prefer-eu" -> policy region: eu-west)? Might speed adoption.
tom: agree. SDKs can emit telemetry `routing.adapter.suggested_map=true` when auto-mapping was applied. Helps console suggest owners.
dan: server change: we'll accept both header and new payload simultaneously during transition, but need a compatibility matrix for rate-limiting + quota. If new payload present use it for routing; if only header present map to policy and record mapping event.
alice: add support CSV: columns tenant_id, api_key_hash, legacy_header_values, mapped_policy_json, owner_email, suggested_auto_map.
rachel: for rollout UX: admin-only flag to "enforce new policies only" so customers can dry-run enforcement before full cutover.
tom: SDK ergonomics: TS export `routing.compat = {enabled: true, ttlReleases: 2}`. Python to log DeprecationWarning on import. Go will add metric `redwood_routing_adapter_mode{mode="legacy"}`.
dan: quota teams: we want a two-week runway where quota reads are aliased and writes go to new keys. After that a reconciliation job migrates totals and resumes writes only to new keys. Need owner for the job.
alice: assign quota-reconcile to `billing` team; I'll add to checklist.
infra-bot: checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/routepolicy-migrate-1728007777 :white_check_mark:
rachel: docs: include Envoy filter snippet, mapping examples, and fallback guidance for edge proxies that rewrite headers. Also include a troubleshooting section for "missing policy" errors.
tom: small devex ask: add `--simulate-policy` flag to SDK CLIs to exercise new payload behavior locally.
dan: edge-case: multi-tenant proxies that aggregate headers could produce ambiguous mappings. We'll surface tenants where header values map to >1 policy as "ambiguous" in CSV.
alice: good. timeline draft: Week0 announce + docs; Week1 console banner + telemetry tag; Week2-5 SDK adapters and mapping UX; Week6 enable tenant dry-run flag; Week8 flip defaults off in SDKs; Week10 stop accepting header in router with 2-week rollback window.
rachel: dashboard tile request: show top 10 ambiguous tenants, top old header values, and quota delta pre/post mapping.
otan: typo: meant tom
tom: noted. I'll add metrics to the infra dashboard once telemetry is live.
alin: (typo: meant alice)
alice: thanks all. I'll own comms + checklist. assigning owners in the checklist. We should also run a small pilot with 5 tenants before broad rollout.
infra-bot: pilot cohort added: tenants [pilot-12, pilot-77, pilot-2, pilot-9, pilot-31]. Pilot start 2024-06-05.
all: ack."
